_README: G.W16 TR-4 — the @keyframes parse corpus manifest. Each row pairs a .css input with its EXPECTED normalized frame structure (the authoritative AST lock: template-frame count + the sorted flattened sub-property keys at the midpoint) and the value-fidelity round-trip mode. `byte` rows must round-trip parse→format→reparse→interpFrames(0.5) BYTE-SAME; the single `epsilon` row (chromatic color) round-trips to within a value.js oklab string float-precision tolerance — a value.js HANDOFF (the oklab parse↔serialize float drift), NOT a kf serializer channel-drop. `text` rows (J.W1 SEAM-3) carry computed-unit values (var()/calc()) that interpolate only against a live DOM box — their oracle is the SERIALIZED TEXT: serialize→reparse→serialize must be BYTE-SAME, every `verbatim` token must appear in the output AUTHORED (never DOM-resolved), and `keys` lock the flattened parsedVars shape instead of the midpoint. Delete a row's `frames`/`keys` and the corpus is no longer authoritative → the gate reds (clause 4).
